judgment.rationale: The public symptom exactly matches a current-source off-by-one at the editor/runtime boundary.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing upstream fix attempt covers the off-by-one.

issue_context.summary: FancyZones Editor previews the predefined 11-zone Priority Grid, but the runtime layout falls back to a regular Grid and places the enlarged zone differently.
known_information: The report specifically identifies the hardcoded 11-zone Priority Grid preview versus runtime fallback.
Current runtime code defines 11 predefined layouts but uses a strict less-than count check.
inferences: The runtime off-by-one excludes the eleventh predefined layout while the editor includes it.
issue_context.analysis: LayoutConfigurator::PriorityGrid calculates predefinedLayoutsCount as 11, then uses zoneCount < predefinedLayoutsCount before indexing zoneCount-1. For zoneCount 11 the condition is false, so runtime calls Grid even though the 11th predefined map exists.
initial_investigation: The same file checks zoneCount < predefinedLayoutsCount, excluding the valid 11th entry.
No pull request referencing issue 28672 was found.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Start the bounded fork-side design workflow. This draft performs no upstream write.

proposed_fixes.title: Include the 11th predefined Priority Grid layout at runtime
proposed_fixes.root_cause: LayoutConfigurator::PriorityGrid uses zoneCount < predefinedLayoutsCount instead of allowing zoneCount equal to the 11-entry table length.
plan: Change the predefined-layout range check to include zone count 11 while preserving the fallback for counts above 11.
Share or cross-check the editor and runtime count boundary so their templates cannot drift.
Add unit/UI assertions comparing preview and applied zone maps for counts 1 through 12.
verification: Apply an 11-zone Priority Grid and verify zones 2/6 are combined exactly as previewed; verify 12 zones still uses regular Grid.

confidence.rationale: The current code contains an exact off-by-one whose output matches the reported 11-zone mismatch.
